create_input_events_processor: create an InputEventsProcessor instance to queue and process thread-safe input events
add_event_to_processor: add a callable receiver with arguments to the InputEventsProcessor event queue
process_queued_events: process all queued events in the InputEventsProcessor by invoking each receiver
create_double_click_detector: create a DoubleClickDetector instance to detect mouse double click events
detect_double_click: process a mouse button and action through the DoubleClickDetector to identify double clicks
